cards.d: An aquarium is a building where fish and underwater animals are kept.
cards.e: We took a trip to the aquarium and saw a scary shark.
cards.ielts: Supporters of public aquariums argue that they educate visitors about marine life and help protect endangered species.

cards.d: If something is arbitrary, it is not based on any plan or system, so it seems random.
cards.e: The classroom had many arbitrary rules that made me confused.
cards.ielts: Setting an arbitrary retirement age of sixty-five ignores the fact that many people can work productively for much longer.

cards.d: An autobiography is a true story of a person’s life written by that person.
cards.e: I read an autobiography about my favorite entertainer.
cards.ielts: Reading the autobiography of a successful entrepreneur inspired me to start my own small business while I was still at university.

cards.d: A convention is behavior that is considered to be common or polite.
cards.e: In the US, a popular convention is to shake hands when you meet someone.
cards.ielts: In many Asian countries, it is a convention to remove your shoes before entering someone’s home.

cards.d: If someone is gracious, then they are kind and helpful to those who need it.
cards.e: The operator was gracious enough to help me find his number.
cards.ielts: The hotel staff were gracious and patient with every guest, which is why the hotel receives such excellent online reviews.

cards.d: To improve something means to make it better.
cards.e: He studied hard to improve his test scores from the previous year.
cards.ielts: Investing in teacher training is one of the most effective ways to improve the quality of education in developing countries.

cards.d: To insulate something means to protect it from heat, cold, or noise.
cards.e: People can conserve energy by insulating their houses.
cards.ielts: Governments should offer grants to help homeowners insulate their houses, which would cut energy bills and carbon emissions.

cards.d: To intrigue means to cause an interest in something or someone.
cards.e: Her mysterious past intrigued her new friend.
cards.ielts: As a child, I was intrigued by the stars, which is why I eventually decided to study astronomy at university.

cards.d: Longevity is the ability to live for a long time.
cards.e: Sea turtles have an amazing longevity.
cards.ielts: Japan is famous for the longevity of its population, which experts attribute to a healthy diet and an active lifestyle.

cards.d: To misplace something means to lose it.
cards.e: I misplaced my wallet, and I didn’t find it until a week later.
cards.ielts: Elderly people with memory problems frequently misplace everyday items such as keys, glasses and important documents.

cards.d: When children are naughty, they behave badly or do not do what they are told.
cards.e: The boy had to go to his room because he was being naughty.
cards.ielts: Some parents believe that children become naughty when they spend too much time watching violent cartoons.

cards.d: A norm is a way of behaving that is considered normal in a particular society.
cards.e: Wearing a heavy coat all summer is not considered a norm in the desert.
cards.ielts: Working from home, which was once unusual, has become the norm for many office workers since the pandemic.

cards.d: An orangutan is a large ape with red and brown hair and long arms.
cards.e: Orangutans use their long arms to swing from trees.
cards.ielts: Palm oil plantations have destroyed much of the rainforest in Borneo, leaving orangutans with fewer places to live.

cards.d: To overload something means to put more things into it than it is meant to hold.
cards.e: If you overload the truck, it might crash.
cards.ielts: Teachers should avoid overloading students with homework, as too much pressure can lead to stress and poor sleep.

cards.d: Philanthropy is the act of helping others, without wanting anything in return.
cards.e: The wealthy business owner is well known for his acts of philanthropy.
cards.ielts: Some billionaires have dedicated much of their fortune to philanthropy, funding schools and hospitals in poor regions.

cards.d: To probe into something means to ask questions to discover facts about it.
cards.e: The bank probed into his financial history to see if he qualified for a loan.
cards.ielts: Journalists probed into the company’s finances and discovered that it had been avoiding taxes for over a decade.

cards.d: A recipient of something is the person who receives it.
cards.e: I was the recipient of four phone calls today.
cards.ielts: The recipients of government scholarships are expected to return to their home country and work there for at least five years.

cards.d: A reptile is a cold-blooded animal that lays eggs and has skin covered with scales.
cards.e: Lizards are my favorite type of reptile.
cards.ielts: Rising temperatures are affecting reptiles such as turtles, whose eggs are highly sensitive to changes in heat.

cards.d: To thrive means to do well and be successful, healthy, or strong.
cards.e: He may be an old man, but he continues to thrive.
cards.ielts: Small businesses tend to thrive in cities where rents are affordable and local governments offer financial support.

cards.d: When something is ultimate, it is the final result or aim of a long series of events.
cards.e: By trying hard in school, I will reach my ultimate goal of becoming a doctor.
cards.ielts: The ultimate aim of education should be to create independent thinkers rather than students who simply memorise facts.
